line_items.description: Ergonomic Office Chair (returned, damaged in transit)

notes: This is a credit note, not an invoice: every amount is negative and so is the total (-21,476.00), because money flows back to the buyer. Quantities are recorded as negative exactly as printed, so quantity x unit price = amount. A client may prefer positive quantities with negative amounts, or positive figures plus a document-type flag. The referenced original invoice (INV-2026-0457) is not the invoice_number here; the credit note's own number CN-2026-0088 is.
